scope: Actual source-certified composite rowid indexes: all physical key fields, per-key collations and scalar programs, tuple/NULL uniqueness, native conflict effects, independent pure/IO record traversal and rollback/WAL files. Finite admitted cases, not global SQLite equivalence.

negative_results.stage: First full composite checkpoint retained collated errors
negative_results.reason: Refactoring key preparation moved generic admission ahead of consumed-collation validation. Four existing native diagnostic regressions caught this order change; consumed-collation errors now precede generic admission again.
SQL rejected key arrays and independent opening could only decode one key plus rowid.

negative_results.stage: Complete key tuples and physical records
negative_results.reason: Actual multi-field records, tuple order, uniqueness, predicates, collations and metadata match.

Nonunique candidate checking still evaluated only the first key, so INSERT, later-row INSERT and UPDATE failed to raise a later-key overflow before publishing the point. All candidate keys now evaluate before the actual write.

Second-key corruption, later-key errors, prefixes, NULL tuples, unique/replace, expression/collated/partial keys, metadata, three keys and overflow records match or correctly reject in both file modes.

implementation: Certified catalog definitions retain the complete key AST array. Each key independently binds actual columns, scalar semantics and comparison metadata.

CoreIndexKey.Entry retains every computed value and the actual rowid as the final record field, without column write affinity. Tuple order uses per-key SQLite comparators then actual rowids; NULL in any component permits distinct UNIQUE rows.

Actual complete key tuples govern unique diagnostics, IGNORE and replacement-victim selection. Nonunique candidate checking evaluates every key before publication, preserving native error/counter/last-rowid behavior on later-key failures.

One monadic pointer/header/fuel traversal serves pure and IO physical acquisition, including promoted interior keys and actual overflow payloads. The independent checker compares every field and actual rowid; collation equality never conceals mismatched stored bytes.

Existing balanced index-page, overflow, rollback and WAL codecs encode the full records. Direct and virtual metadata expose every key. Narrow CoreDecode responsibilities are explicitly imported by its facade and documented; ordinary single-column admission remains on its original branch. The C VFS shim is unchanged.

evaluation_protocols.public_file_modes: 7614 complete stdout/exit/first-error and independent persisted catalog/row/integrity comparisons, including 86 composite-index cases, two of which intentionally corrupt only a later physical key.
evaluation_protocols.same_connection: 284 actual API continuation cases: 167 general, 29 partial, 27 expression, 31 collated and 30 new composite cases, reported separately.
evaluation_protocols.crashes: 444 finite SIGKILL timing samples, including 24 new composite-record samples; actual production recovery followed by independent SQLite schema/row/index-key/cookie/integrity observations. No every-syscall, power-loss, arbitrary-schedule or global root identity claim.
evaluation_protocols.named_features: The original 88-probe survey still has four failures: WITHOUT ROWID and composite primary keys, each in both file modes. Supporting explicit composite indexes is a prerequisite for the remaining composite-table constraints. This finite survey is not a global coverage percentage.

proof_scope: All retained contracts and required audits compile. Newly audited laws preserve actual rowids in physical keyEntry projection, give the key-record width, recover nonempty key tuples from recordValues and preserve NULL-leading uniqueness. Existing checked-image/journal contracts consume the actual all-field decoder. The new maintained Lean group checks tuple order and widths, record-value roundtrips, prefix/NULL distinctions, actual IGNORE/REPLACE victims and complete physical metadata. No global composite-index/SQL/planner equivalence theorem is claimed.
limitations: Four original named survey failures remain: WITHOUT ROWID and composite primary keys, both file modes.

Composite/implicit collated PRIMARY/UNIQUE table constraints, descending index keys, auxiliary query-planner/foreign-parent admission, recursive auxiliary REPLACE with DELETE programs, non-ABORT primary policies, ALTER, UPSERT, UTF-16 auxiliary index IO and broader scalar error/phase combinations remain work.
Bulk physical root-page layout is not globally SQLite-identical; pending new-object schema metadata and larger root-preservation cases remain separate work.
Wider error codes/phases, FAIL/IGNORE/ROLLBACK controls, triggered UPSERT, INSTEAD OF/temp triggers, writable CTEs, trigger-aware ALTER and deferred private-function declarations remain work.

UTF-16 writes/setters, native-key/materialization limits, pending new physical allocations and earlier SQL/storage limitations remain. The finite process-kill samples do not establish every syscall/power-loss schedule.
